summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of NivX Machines. All 9 pytest tests pass (root, auth login/me + 401 cases, threats list/get/404, auth-required CRUD, live CISA KEV feed). Landing page loads with all sections (hero, live threat landscape with 1,635 CVEs and 24 feed rows, threat cards + detail dialog, gallery, services, careers, support). Admin login/create/edit/delete/logout all functional.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — accessibility warning in console

action_items: Minor: Navbar uses data-testid 'nav-threats' (plural) whereas review request referenced 'nav-threat'. Not a bug — actual link works and scrolls to Threat Report section. Optionally align spec/testid.
Minor: Add DialogDescription to threat-detail-dialog to remove aria-describedby console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend seed_admin correctly updates admin password if changed — good idempotency.
Backend properly excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} in threat queries — no ObjectId leakage.
JWT stored in localStorage (Bearer flow) as per spec; also accepts cookie fallback in get_current_user — matches design.
Live feed cache (30 min) prevents overloading CISA endpoint — good.
server.py is a single 366-line file; still under 700 line threshold but growing — consider splitting auth/threats/live-feed into modules soon.
seed_data_creation: 3 threat reports auto-seeded on backend startup. Test suite creates/deletes TEST_* prefixed reports and cleans up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under /api all healthy. CISA live feed working (24 items). Admin flow uses Bearer token 'nivx_token' in localStorage. Nav testids use plural 'nav-threats' (id='threats'), not 'nav-threat'. Toast library shows Deleted/Created toast after mutations.
